category_summary: **Official Hermes Agent Updates:** The week's clear headline is **NousResearch**'s announcement that [web search in Hermes Agent is now fast and free](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-ba4064c60ef3), powered by **Perplexity Fast Search** — massive engagement (2,300+ likes) and an enthusiastic community reception make it the #1 item. **Teknium** was highly active in support threads, confirming [macOS availability](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-9611df373a59) and [cross-platform compatibility](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-f2481eb3a38e) (**Windows**/**Linux**) and [pointing users toward the plugin directory](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-ec2e980ebd35); he also promoted an [AI community event in Bangkok](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-b4f9de674ac4) (122 likes, 14K views) worth flagging for readers in the region. A brief [official reply clarifying that Wizards are open-source coded](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-340033a92376) was welcomed by the OSS-minded segment of the community. **Oh-My-Hermes Plugin Ecosystem:** **rlaope** drove most of the community-tooling conversation with the [Oh-My-Hermes (OMH) all-in-one plugin](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-e5a0ed4c9cb5) (coding intelligence, subagent workflow auto-routing, long-term memory) and a [follow-up feature drop of six Jev skills](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-53bb4a10b33c) bringing typed decision-making into Hermes workflows (omh-jev-ask, omh-jev-route, omh-jev-failure-triage, omh-jev-review-gate and more). Sentiment here is mixed: genuine interest in the plugin's capabilities, but skepticism toward the [self-promotional "50 billion tokens" runtime teaser](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-6f6c6f488a51) and the bare-link spam, plus a [heated public spat between rlaope and noxleeminho](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-2e83e00501b0) over the **JEV** paid-access model that generated friction rather than information. **Broader AI Ecosystem News:** [Sakana AI hiring Jürgen Schmidhuber as Chief Scientific Advisor](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-c6a5b29ef5d1) was the biggest adjacent story and resonated strongly; **hardmaru** provided valuable context, noting [Schmidhuber's 1990s pioneering work on meta-learning, recursive self-improvement, and world models](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-fa83d407c7d0), and that [Sakana's Tokyo RSI Lab now under his direction builds on ideas that inspired the Darwin Gödel Machine and The AI Scientist](/?date=2026-09-25&category=social#item-d2d4ca123b17). **Filtered out:** heart-emoji posts, duplicate bare-link shares, and low-engagement personal replies (including the rest of the rlaope/noxleeminho argument thread) were excluded as low informational value; the three near-duplicate macOS compatibility confirmations are represented by the single highest-scoring instance.

items.title:
OMH New Feature: Jev Skills

Six new skills bring Jev’s typed decision-making into Hermes workflows:...
items.content:
OMH New Feature: Jev Skills

Six new skills bring Jev’s typed decision-making into Hermes workflows:

• omh-jev-ask
Ask yes/no, pick-one, or scored questions and get probabilities instead of prose.

• omh-jev-route
Use Jev to choose between workflows when OMH routing is uncertain.

• omh-jev-failure-triage
Decide whether to retry, fix a dependency, request access, or change the approach after a failure.

• omh-jev-review-gate
Flag authentication, test coverage, migration, and severity risks in code diffs.

• omh-jev-action-check
Screen risky commands for secret exposure, outbound actions, and blast radius before execution.

• omh-jev-done-check
Test completion claims against observed evidence and surface anything still missing.

Jev provides the probabilities. OMH applies the workflow rules. Execution, approval, and merge decisions remain under user control.

OMH: https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E

#jev #hermes
